notes: IFOToken is an ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 IFO once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers are fee-free. No external mint, burn, administrator or upgrade functions exist. There are no application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
